title: Hole transport layer selection for stable and efficient carbon electrode-based perovskite solar cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13681-13690
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01694K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kausar Ali Khawaja, Wenjun Xiang, Jacob Wall, Xiaoyu Gu, Lin Li, Feng Yan
This study compares Spiro-OMeTAD, CuSCN, and PTAA as hole transport layers in carbon-based perovskite solar cells. Spiro-OMeTAD showed best efficiency, CuSCN better stability, while PTAA underperformed, highlighting a performance-stability trade-off.
